title_zh: 了解顺序数：飞行扫把不见了
title_en: Understanding Ordinal Numbers: The Flying Broom is Missing
source_file: 了解顺序数：飞行扫把不见了（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 袋鼠妈妈童书
数学来了！
理解第一、第二、第三等顺序数
了解顺序数
飞行扫把不见了
钟林姣 文 李妮娜 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 小女巫笑咪咪从魔法村搬到了蜜糖小镇。
蜜糖小镇是个漂亮的镇子，这里有很多的糖果生产工厂，工厂
的烟囱里不断飘出七色的烟雾，空气中散发着香香甜甜的味儿。

[P3] “我都骑着扫把飞行了一万三千千米了，实在是太累了，我要好好休息一下。”
她还来不及布置，家里连一把可以让她休息的椅子都没有！
没关系，变一把椅子是很简单的魔法。
瞧，椅子有了。
笑咪咪小女巫美美地睡了一觉。可当她醒来准备去采购东西的时候，她却发现自己的飞行扫把不见了。
不着急，她的扫把很调皮，说不定故意躲着让她找呢。

[P4] 窗帘后面？窗外的大树上？没有！
也许扫把逃跑了。
鲁斯爷爷的炸鸡店？没有！
菲力叔叔的巧克力小铺？没有！
安娜奶奶的洋娃娃小摊上？没有！
玛丽婶婶的面包店？没有！
爱丽丝姐姐的果汁店？没有！

[P5] 便当屋
在十字路口指挥交通
的费特警官有看到吗？
“一把扫把？真抱歉，
我没有看到。”
约翰哥哥的便当屋？没有！
花店
美丽的花店里也不见扫把的影子。
糖果屋
艾米莉阿姨的糖果店？没有！
MICKEY PARK
难道去游乐场玩了？——哦，游乐场里也没有。

[P6] 真让人着急。扫把是女巫的飞行工具！没有扫把，笑咪咪小女巫过几天就没法回魔法村参加祖母的生日会，也没办法去遥远的北极旅行，更没办法去魔法城堡参加小女巫晋级考试了。
这可怎么办？
笑咪咪小女巫的扫把不见了，蜜糖小镇的居民都很着急，大家都想帮帮小女巫。那就送一把新的扫把给她吧！

[P7] 第一个送来扫把的是安娜奶奶，她送来的是芦花扫把。
第二个送来扫把的是鲁斯爷爷，他送来的是稻草扫把。
第三个送来扫把的是玛丽婶婶，她送来的是高粱扫把。
第四个送来扫把的是菲力叔叔，他送来的是麦秆扫把。
第五个送来扫把的是爱丽丝姐姐，她送来的是苹果枝扫把，上面还有两个苹果呢。
“谢谢您，我的扫把不是这样的。”
第六个送来扫把的是约翰哥哥，他送来的是狗尾巴草扫把。
第七个送来扫把的是艾米莉阿姨，她送来的是棒棒糖扫把，真诱人啊。
第八个送来扫把的是费特警官，他送来的是常青藤扫把，这扫把看起来真像一条绿裙子。
第九个送来扫把的是游乐场门卫克里克伯伯，他送来的是机器人扫把。
“听说它还能飞，不过我没试过。”
笑咪咪小女巫的扫把到底在哪里呢？

[P8] 第十个送扫把的人来了，她是小女孩茜茜。她的手里抱着一大捧雏菊——这就是她送来的扫把吗？
“不不不，我丢的不是雏菊扫把。”笑咪咪小女巫说。
“我知道呀。”小女孩茜茜把雏菊插在桌子上的玻璃花瓶里，“我是想说，你喜欢变魔法，那就把漂亮的雏菊变成扫把，不就行了？”
“啊……”笑咪咪小女巫一拍脑袋，“我想起来了——我的扫把在这儿。”
终于找到它了——
没错，它就是那把椅子。
哈哈，原来她的柳条扫把被她变成了椅子。

[P9] “谢谢！”笑咪咪小女巫不但要感谢第一个送来扫把的安娜奶奶，她还要感谢其他人，特别要感谢提醒她的小女孩茜茜。哦，别忘了茜茜是第十个来的。
现在，笑咪咪小女巫可以去魔法村参加祖母的生日会了——这真是让人高兴的事情。
“再见！”
“我会很快回来的！”

[P10] 美味面包店
笑咪咪小女巫去玛丽婶婶的面包店买面包，发现好多人在排队。
仔细观察图片，按顺序说出谁是第
几个走出面包店的人，比如：“安娜奶奶第一个走出面包店。”

按顺序买扫把
笑咪咪小女巫想买一把打扫卫生的扫把。
呀，原来这么多人等着买扫把啊！请认真观察图片，在第三个买扫把的人的头上贴一朵花，在第七个买扫把的人的头上贴一个月亮，在第九个买扫把的人的头上贴一颗星星。
full_text_en:
[P1] Kangaroo Mommy Children's Books
Math is Here!
Understanding ordinal numbers like first, second, third
Understanding Ordinal Numbers
The Flying Broomstick is Missing
Written by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrated by Li Nina
Jin Dun Publishing House

[P2] Little witch Xiaomimi moved from Magic Village to Candy Town.
Candy Town is a beautiful town with many candy factories. Colorful smoke rises from the factory chimneys, and the air is filled with a sweet, delicious smell.

[P3] "I've been flying on my broom for 13,000 kilometers, I'm really tired. I need to rest for a while."
She hadn't even had time to set up her new home—there wasn't even a chair for her to rest on!
No problem. Turning a chair is simple magic.
Look, a chair appears.
Little witch Xiaomeimei slept soundly. But when she woke up and prepared to go shopping, she found her flying broom was gone.
Don't worry, her broom is very mischievous. Maybe it's hiding on purpose, waiting for her to find it.

[P4] Behind the curtain? On the big tree outside? No!
Maybe the broom has run away.
Grandpa Ruth's fried chicken shop? No!
Uncle Philip's chocolate shop? No!
Grandma Anna's doll stall? No!
Aunt Mary's bakery? No!
Sister Alice's juice shop? No!

[P5] Bento Shop
At the crossroads, the traffic officer Fete, is there any sight of it?
"A broom? I'm sorry, I didn't see it."
John's bento shop? No!
Flower Shop
The beautiful flower shop has no trace of the broom.
Candy Shop
Aunt Emily's candy shop? No!
MICKEY PARK
Could it have gone to the playground? — Oh, not there either.

[P6] This is really worrying. The broom is a witch's flying tool! Without it, Little Witch Xiaomimi won't be able to return to Magic Village for her grandmother's birthday party in a few days, can't go on a trip to the distant North Pole, and can't even go to the Magic Castle for the little witch promotion exam.
What should we do?
Little Witch Xiaomimi's broom is missing, and the residents of Candy Town are all very worried. Everyone wants to help the little witch. Let's give her a new broom!

[P7] The first one to bring a broom is Grandma Anna, and she brings a reed broom.
The second one to bring a broom is Grandpa Ruth, and he brings a straw broom.
The third one to bring a broom is Auntie Mary, and she brings a sorghum broom.
The fourth one to bring a broom is Uncle Philip, and he brings a wheat straw broom.
The fifth one to bring a broom is Sister Alice, and she brings an apple branch broom, with two apples on it.
"Thank you, but my broom is not like this."
The sixth one to bring a broom is Brother John, and he brings a dog-tail grass broom.
The seventh one to bring a broom is Aunt Emily, and she brings a lollipop broom, so tempting!
The eighth one to bring a broom is Officer Fett, and he brings an ivy broom, which looks like a green skirt.
The ninth one to bring a broom is Uncle Krick, the gatekeeper of the amusement park, and he brings a robot broom.
"I heard it can fly, but I haven't tried it yet."
Where on earth is Little Witch Xiaomeimi's broom?

[P8] The tenth person to bring a broom has arrived—she is the little girl, Xixi. She is holding a big bunch of daisies—is this the broom she brought?
"No, no, no, the broom I lost isn't a daisy broom," said Little Witch Xiaomeimei.
"I know," said little girl Xixi, placing the daisies into a glass vase on the table. "I was thinking, since you like magic, why not turn these beautiful daisies into a broom? That would work, right?"
"Ah..." Little Witch Xiaomeimei slapped her forehead. "I remember now—my broom is right here!"
Finally found it—
Yes, it's that chair.
Ha ha, it turns out her wicker broom had been turned into a chair by her own magic.

[P9] "Thank you!" Little witch Xiaomeimei not only thanks Grandma Anna, who brought the first broom, but also thanks everyone else, especially little girl Xixi, who reminded her. Oh, don't forget Xixi was the tenth to arrive.
Now, Little witch Xiaomeimei can go to Magic Village to attend her grandmother's birthday party—what a joyful thing!
"Goodbye!"
"I'll be back soon!"

[P10] Delicious Bakery
Little witch Xiaomeimei goes to Aunt Mary's bakery to buy bread and finds many people queuing.
Carefully observe the picture and say in order who is the first, second, etc. to leave the bakery, for example: "Grandma Anna is the first to leave the bakery."

Buying Brooms in Order
Little witch Xiaomeimei wants to buy a broom for cleaning.
Wow, so many people are waiting to buy brooms! Please carefully observe the picture, put a flower on the head of the third person buying a broom, a moon on the head of the seventh person, and a star on the head of the ninth person.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本的封面页，标题为《了解顺序数》，副标题为《飞行扫把不见了》，作者为钟林姣，绘者为李妮娜，由金盾出版社出版。画面中一位老奶奶站在摊位旁，摊位内有三个小女孩和一只小白兔。
[P2] 小女巫笑咪咪从魔法村搬到了蜜糖小镇，画面展示了由糖果和甜点构成的梦幻小镇，烟囱飘着七彩烟雾，空气中弥漫着甜香。
[P3] 小女巫笑咪咪刚搬到新家，用魔法变出椅子休息，醒来后发现飞行扫把不见了，但她认为扫把只是调皮地躲起来了。
[P4] 小女巫笑咪咪在蜜糖小镇的各个地方寻找失踪的飞行扫把，包括窗帘后、大树上、炸鸡店、巧克力店、洋娃娃摊、面包店和果汁店，但都一无所获。
[P5] 小女巫笑咪咪继续在蜜糖小镇寻找失踪的飞行扫把，她询问了十字路口的费特警官，并检查了便当屋、花店、糖果屋和游乐场，但均未找到扫把。
[P6] 小女巫笑咪咪因飞行扫把失踪而焦急，因为扫把是她参加重要活动的必需品。蜜糖小镇的居民得知后，纷纷主动提出要送她一把新的扫把。
[P7] 小女巫笑咪咪在蜜糖小镇寻找失踪的飞行扫把，九位居民依次送来不同类型的扫把，但都不是她需要的飞行扫把，她礼貌地拒绝了，最后画面以疑问句结尾，暗示扫把仍未找到。
[P8] 第十个居民小女孩茜茜送来一捧雏菊作为扫把，小女巫笑咪咪拒绝后，突然想起自己的飞行扫把其实被她用魔法变成了椅子。
[P9] 小女巫笑咪咪感谢帮助她的居民，特别是提醒她扫把去向的小女孩茜茜，随后骑上飞行扫把前往魔法村参加祖母的生日会，并承诺很快回来。
[P10] 本页包含两个互动游戏：左侧是让读者按顺序识别从面包店走出的人物，右侧是让读者在排队买扫把的人群中，按顺序为第三、第七和第九个人贴上花、月亮和星星。
